en.title: IRS launches new mobile app, expanding digital services for taxpayers
en.summary: The IRS today announced the launch of the new IRS mobile app, replacing IRS2Go and expanding the agency’s digital services to give taxpayers more ways to securely access IRS tools and account services from their mobile devices.

en.title: The Trump administration advances the establishment of America’s first nationwide school choice program
en.summary: The Department of the Treasury and the IRS issued proposed regulations to implement the new Federal Scholarship Tax Credit under section 25F, commonly known as the Education Freedom Tax Credit, the first federal tax credit supporting private contributions for K-12 scholarships.

en.title: The IRS seeks community partners and volunteers to support free tax services
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service’s Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) and Tax Counseling for the Elderly (TCE) programs are seeking volunteers and community partners to help provide free tax preparation services during the upcoming filing season.

es.title: El IRS lanza nueva aplicación móvil y amplía servicios digitales para contribuyentes
es.summary: El IRS anunció hoy el lanzamiento de la nueva aplicación móvil IRS, la cual reemplaza a IRS2Go y amplía los servicios digitales de la agencia para ofrecer a los contribuyentes más formas de acceder de manera segura a las herramientas y servicios de cuenta del IRS desde sus dispositivos móviles.
